pr.body: Implemented an in-memory operation history in tasktracker/store.py. Undoing add removes the task without decrementing the ID counter; undoing complete restores the prior status; undoing delete restores the original Task object under its original ID. Failed operations are not added to history, and exhausted history raises NothingToUndo. Added focused tests in tests/test_basic.py. Checks: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` (8 passed), `git diff --check` (passed). No dependencies added; README confirms standard-library-only project.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for successful task additions, completions, and deletions. Before: TaskStore operations could not be undone; now callers can reverse them while IDs remain monotonic.
pr.title: Add undo for task store operations

risk.why: Contained behavior change adding undo history behind the existing TaskStore interface. Covered by focused acceptance tests; no persistence, concurrency, security, or external API changes.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement TT-101 exactly as written in BACKLOG.md: define tasktracker.dates.InvalidDate (ValueError subclass) and ensure malformed forms and impossible calendar dates raise it with original input in the message. Preserve case-insensitive today/tomorrow and whitespace handling. Accept only nonnegative signed +Nd offsets; +0d is today, while negative and unsigned offsets are invalid. Add focused tests for all acceptance criteria, retain existing tests, use only the Python standard library, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Make and commit only this ticket as its own commit.
